# behavioral/body-only changes are ignored by deterministic delta

The system deliberately treats body-only edits as producing an empty deterministic delta (bodies are delegated to the LLM/business-rule layer). This means semantic/behavioral changes inside function bodies may not be captured by the deterministic compilation delta.

**Anchored to:**

- `tests/test_incremental.py` — `tests.test_incremental.test_pr_compile_produces_precise_delta`
